<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0042026-03-0409-24-50" status="unreviewed">
                  yang <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834"><choice><reg>rgya</reg><orig>(rgya)</orig></choice></rs><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya</rs></note><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">kha 1</rs> na re dgag bya rnam par ba du ldog la dngos 'gal gyi mtshan nyid du byas na mtshan gzhi sngon po dang sngo ma yin la ltos pa'i dgag bya rnaM par bcad ldog la tha dad Na pa'i nyes pa gnas pas
               <lb n="84b3"/>dgag bya rnaM par bcad ldog du blos zhen du rung ba mtshan nyid yin no zhes zer ba ni ma yin te | dgag bya dang sngo ma yin la tha dad yod dam Na dang po ltar na sngon po dang dgag bya rnaM par chad ldog la yang tha dad yod do || 2 pa ltar na dung dang dkar tsam la yang tha dad Na pa ni 'gog de ltar na dang khegs na dkar tsam khegs par thal ba yin no zhe na |
               <lb n="84b4"/>'diral ya sngo ma yin khegs na dgag bya tsam khegs par thal ba las bsags pa yod pa yin no || </seg></TEI>
